high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a presentation slide from Waymo, a subsidiary of Alphabet Inc., showcasing the timeline of their autonomous vehicle development and deployment. Header: The top of the slide features the Waymo logo, which consists of a stylized "W" in green and blue colors. Below the logo, the word "WAYMO" is written in uppercase letters. Timeline: The slide includes a vertical timeline with three key years marked: 2015: Austin, Texas 2017: Phoenix East Valley
